title: Payroll Cost
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Payroll cost in the period
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(pl.gross_pay + pl.employer_taxes + pl.benefits), 2) FROM dash_demo.payroll_lines pl JOIN dash_demo.employees e USING (employee_id) JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE date_trunc('month', pl.period_month) = DATE '2026-09-01'

kpis.label: Average gross pay
kpis.sql: SELECT round(avg(pl.gross_pay), 2) FROM dash_demo.payroll_lines pl JOIN dash_demo.employees e USING (employee_id) JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE date_trunc('month', pl.period_month) = DATE '2026-09-01'

kpis.label: Overtime hours
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(pl.overtime_hours), 2) FROM dash_demo.payroll_lines pl JOIN dash_demo.employees e USING (employee_id) JOIN dash_demo.departments d USING (department_id) WHERE date_trunc('month', pl.period_month) = DATE '2026-09-01'

kpis.label: Warehouse overtime in November and December against the rest
kpis.sql: SELECT round((SELECT avg(pl.overtime_hours) FROM dash_demo.payroll_lines pl JOIN dash_demo.employees e USING (employee_id) WHERE e.department_id = 7 AND month(pl.period_month) IN (11, 12)) / (SELECT avg(pl.overtime_hours) FROM dash_demo.payroll_lines pl JOIN dash_demo.employees e USING (employee_id) WHERE e.department_id = 7 AND month(pl.period_month) NOT IN (11, 12)), 2)
